method: Outlier = a reel whose Views are >= 5x the account's follower count (per the viral-marketing tutorial practice adopted 2026-11-16). Extract each outlier's first 3 seconds (opening frame/action, first on-screen text, first spoken line) as the hook reference for future scripts.
views_data_note: Instagram does not expose competitor reel Views through instagram-cli (posts returns likes/comments; individual-post-insights works only for the account owner's own posts — verified 2026-11-16, competitor post returned media_not_found). Following strategy.md's standing convention (use likes when Views cannot be obtained), ratios here are likes-based. Because Views >= Likes on every reel, Tier A (likes >= 5x followers) satisfies the Views criterion with certainty; Tier A' uses the account's documented follower count at posting time; Tier B (likes 0.15x-1.4x followers) are probable view-outliers given typical reel like-rates of ~2-5% of views, but their Views are UNCONFIRMED — treat Tier B hooks as candidates, not proven outliers.
scan_note: 18 accounts scanned 2026-11-16; last 30 posts each; 339 video posts analyzed. japan.tips (15 followers, 0 posts), japan.manners (4 followers) and tokyo_tipsin60 (0 followers) have no meaningful follower base and are excluded from ranking. Follower counts are at scan time except Tier A' (at posting, from strategy.md 2026-11-15 survey).
